cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, sign that my fence can stay on our boundary. I'll wait here while you choose your wording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I suppose it can. Does that count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As the start. Write 'can stay' beside your name; I'll decide we're finished when the permission is clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever. Could we make it just today's agreement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can. Write today's date. You keep a copy; I'll take mine to the builder. If you want to change it, bring your copy to me and we'll mark the change together.
